search_text: published ZDI-21-1000 ZDI-CAN-13543 (Pwn2Own) Parallels Desktop WinAppHelper Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-08-25 CVE-2021-34864 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-34864 8.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Parallels'] ['Desktop'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WinAppHelper component. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the hypervisor. title: (Pwn2Own) Parallels Desktop WinAppHelper Improper Access Control Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Parallels Desktop. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WinAppHelper component. The issue results from the lack of proper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the hypervisor.
